name: Linker Bell Academia ~Rakudai Majo to Himitsu no Gishiki~
original_name: リンカーベル・アカデミア～落第魔女とヒミツの儀式～
source:
Misaki Hiro is normal student without any special trait or talent. One day, he is suddenly sent to a different world filled with magic by a mysterious goddess. His first meeting in the new world is with Eros Strobel who is student of all-girls magic school. Since his appearance overlaps with her summoning magic, she treats him as her familiar and has him stay at the school. There he meets up with her friends: the lazy senior human-beast Hibiki Flamel and stoic but kind Melusine Dragonette from the Dragon tribe.

Later, at the same time when he knows about the trio is actually useless students who can't use magic, the girls also realize his special ability that they can use magic when holding hand with him. They welcome him to their "Soundless Club" as savior with expectation that things will change from now on.
translation:
三崎Hiro是个没有特殊才能的普通学生。某天，他突然被一位神秘女神送到了充满魔法的异世界。来到这里后，他首先遇见了女子魔法学园的学生，厄洛斯·施特罗贝尔。由于他的出现恰好与她施展召唤魔法的时机重合，厄洛斯便将他当成使魔，让他留在学园。在这里，他结识了她的朋友，懒散的兽人学姐Hibiki·弗拉梅尔，以及沉默寡言、内心温柔的龙族少女梅露西娜·德拉戈内特。

后来，他得知三人其实都是无法使用魔法的落第生。与此同时，女孩们也发现了他的特殊能力，只要与他牵手，她们就能施展魔法。三人将他当作救星，迎进了自己的“无声部”，满怀期待地相信，从此一切都会改变。
